status: The layout spec for the sitting on the LVGL face: every drawn region names its word or composition, the states pose, place, confirm, begin and portrait, the focus as data, the events, the bottom line and the strings
note: The one home of the sitting's numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Sitting) and its wireframes 14-sitting-pose.svg to 14d-sitting-nav.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The sitting spends a held sitting on one mibi: the player picks a pose from its habits and a place it has been, looks, and confirms. Its left half is Habitat's living window, unchanged, so the mibi stays where it stood; the choices are in the deck at the right (Habitat's right column, the namer's panel rectangle), the three steps along the foot. Every rectangle is on the 8 px grid.

notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every event on this screen is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end (a hand-off, a jump, the next state) on the frame of the key; nothing waits on a still frame. The backdrop's dither is a cut; begin lands on one mibi up close, the ring on the Portrait module, on the frame of the second ✓, and its plate shows. A press that ends an event with `cut: true` also acts (habitat.json notes.cut); no event here cuts.
notes.where: its own screen under one mibi up close (frame.json navigation.screens.sitting: parent habitat, back {name}), opened from its Portrait module with ✓ Portray {name}, only while a sitting is held and the mibi can sit (sitting.portraitBlock empty: it has a habit seen and a place been); and, in state portrait, opened from wherever `regions.portrait.offeredFrom` lists
notes.rules: prototypes/station/src/sitting.mjs: offer(st, m) gives the poses (the habits seen, habitsOf) and the places (where it has been, placesOf); beginSitting(st, m, pose, place) spends the held sitting and nothing else, sends the crate to the bay and sets the mibi's portrait painting. Nothing is spent before the last ✓
notes.window: the same bezel, glass, mibi and name tag as Habitat, so the screen change keeps the mibi where it stood. On the pose step the glass and the resident are Habitat's own, in the hour's light. From the place step on, the window previews the portrait: the place's backdrop in its own day light, and the resident drawn ungraded with it (art director, 2026-10-23 19:26 §3)
notes.frame: the gilt frame around the window from the look-and-confirm step: the portrait to be. It lights when the confirm is armed
notes.visit: inside the screen ← keeps every choice; leaving the screen (← from the pose step, a room key) drops every choice, and coming back starts on the pose step with the ring on card.0
notes.order: the order of the cards is the frame's: poses in the species frame's habit order (the habits seen); places the pod's place first, then the order walked to (a bred mibi has only the places it walked to)
notes.amber: nothing on the sitting is amber

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc
rules.listPitch: the cards (three columns, two rows), the chosen cards and the three step tiles are lists by pitch: { first, pitch, grid }

stateRule: pose: pick one of the mibi's habits seen. place: pick one of the places it has been. confirm: look at the choice in the gilt frame and confirm, arm-then-confirm. begin: from the second ✓ until the screen changes to Habitat (events.begin), input held. ✓ on a card goes a step forward; ← goes a step back (from pose, to Habitat). A region with `inStates` exists only in those states. portrait: the finished portrait in the gilt frame, at rest, view only (GD-3); nothing to choose and nothing spent; entered only from `regions.portrait.offeredFrom` and only while the picture is held

pictures.pose: the same vivarium-near-{light}-544x408 as Habitat (habitat.json regions.glass), the hour's light
pictures.place: sitting-backdrop-{place}-544x408 of the focused place card, day light, never graded by the hour
pictures.confirm: sitting-backdrop-{place}-544x408 of the chosen place, day light, seen through the gilt's opening

glass.load: the place backdrops load on entering the place step and are dropped on leaving the screen; the pose step's glass is Habitat's, already loaded
glass.note: no words but the name tag; the light rule is notes.window

resident.place: x = 296 − dx − ⌊W/2⌋, y = 380 − dy − H + 1, from props regions.resident.figure (habitat.json, 16.15 placement)
resident.picture: the same picture as the focused card (pose) or the chosen pose card (place, confirm, begin): this mibi in that habit's held key at the Habitat factor (stand-sizes views.habitat), in the 304 × 312 place, feet on 380

form.sleep-curled: the layered curl, its last solid row on 380, no shadow
form.a habit with no signed key: the stand (the 16.15 placement), as its card shows; listed as a placeholder (masters.placeholders)
form.S02, S03: the species stand-in in every pose; never a nap master scaled up

resident.change: the change of form or light rides the step's cut, or the backdrop's dither on the place step (timing: the animator, AN-1)
resident.never: a painting (decision 10-11 14:17 (4)); the portrait is not shown before it is painted

nameTag.slot: state portrait: the tag's slot only, nothing drawn
nameTag.note: as on Habitat; not a target here

portrait.picture: props regions.portrait.picture: portrait:<d16>:528x392, 1:1 in the gilt's opening
portrait.over: the glass; under the gilt (at rest)
portrait.offeredRule: habitat-portrayed: Habitat's Portrait module, portrayed and its picture held, ✓ strings.lookPortrait; cargo-end: Cargo's end after a run that opened this mibi's sitting crate, ✓ before Look at the pods
portrait.until: not entered: the state is offered only while the picture is held

props.lit: focus.armed === "room" (confirm only; never lit in portrait: the art director's ruling, 19:26 §5)

gilt.look: a modelled moulding 16 px deep on every side: outer bead 3 px, leaf face 8 px lit from the top left, inner shade lip 3 px, sight edge 2 px; lit is the leaf one value brighter with a 2 px warm sight edge; the sitting's gold, never the focus colour
gilt.standIn: colours.giltStandIn: the wireframes' stand-in until the masters land; the build draws only the masters
gilt.note: over the bezel; its opening sits 8 px inside the glass on every side, the mibi and its tag inside it

deck.note: the right column in every state

portrait.rule: 20 px, or 16 when 20 does not fit 248

card.pose: this mibi in that habit's held key, whole art fitted, 96 × 96, day light (never graded by the hour), transparent on the well's own ground; derived by the station's reducer, no master
card.place: place-{place}-96x96, full bleed in the same 96

cards.order: the frame's: poses as sitting.mjs offer gives them (already in the species frame's habit order); places, the pod's place first, then the order walked to

chosen.note: the pose's card, then the place's card, as chosen; not targets

stamp.as: habitat.json regions.stamp: the same picture, size and look (stampCase); no postmark in the first build

portrayed.when: the mibi is portrayed (always, in this state)
portrayed.rule: in the label's top-right corner, never over the stamp's cells: its opaque pixels stay clear of the largest stamp (104 at 880, 72) by 1 px on the diagonal (measured on the master)

items.picture: <48 picture id> | null, only when done

thumb.pose: the chosen pose card's picture by the same rule at 48 × 48 (whole art fitted, day light), no ground of its own, as a bay tile

backdrop.do: the place step: the ring moved to another place card; the backdrop cross-dithers to that place's (lvgl-switch.md §2.7). Entering the place step dithers from Habitat's vivarium-near-{light} to the focused place's backdrop, the resident from the hour's light to ungraded; going back to the pose step dithers to vivarium-near-{light}, the resident to the hour's light. The light never flips direction (every backdrop keeps the top-left key)

step.do: ✓ on a card or ← inside: the heading, the cards, the steps' tiles and the bottom line change on the frame of the key (cuts); the gilt frame shows on the confirm step (a cut); the resident's form follows the focused or chosen pose card on the same frame

begin.presses: the pad, ✓ and ← do nothing; a coloured key waits and acts when the hold ends (focus.held)

steps.do: the lit gilt frame dithers out: the frame leaves for the bay
the standard screen transition to Habitat, the ring on the Portrait module in its painting state; the message plate (home.plate)

begin.then: Habitat: the plate (home.plate) and the Portrait module in its painting state

pose.initial: the card chosen before in this visit, else card.0
pose.entry: card.0: opening the screen always starts here, no choice made (notes.visit)

card.id: card.<i>, i from 0 in the cards' order

confirm.armed: room: after the first ✓; regions.gilt.props.lit is focus.armed === "room"; any key but ✓ clears the arm
confirm.room: the ring on nothing: the gilt frame is the focus; ✓ arms, then begins

portrait.room: the ring on nothing; view only

focus.held: while events.begin holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent but room:<x> (kept by the host and dispatched when the hold ends)

keys.pad: pose and place: moves the ring among the cards; confirm and portrait: nothing
keys.confirm: pose: this pose, then the place step; place: this place, then the confirm step; confirm: the first ✓ arms (the gilt frame lights), the second begins the sitting (events.begin); portrait: nothing (no cap)
keys.back: a step back, keeping the choice made there (the ring on it): confirm to place, place to pose; from pose, Habitat with the ring on the Portrait module (habitat.json focus.entry.backFromSitting), the choices dropped. Nothing is spent; from portrait, Habitat with the ring on the Portrait module (habitat.json focus.entry.backFromPortrait)
keys.room: as everywhere (frame.json navigation.roomKeys); leaving drops every choice and nothing is spent, as on Create and Cross

bottomLine.backCap: the ← cap's x is 1008 − the word's width − 20 (the 16 px cap, 4 px, the word right-aligned to 1008): Habitat 54 px → 934, Pose 38 → 950, Place 42 → 946

masters.note: every master the sitting names, at the size it is shown; none is drawn by the build

placeholders.rule: a derived pose card or thumb whose habit has no signed key shows the derived stand and is a placeholder ("habit key owed"), never a delivery; no golden may show one

strings.title: Sitting
strings.habits: the habit as its phrase in habitat.json strings.watchHabits ("shaking itself dry", "calming a creature", "curled up asleep", "sniffing", "puffing out its down", "digging", "glowing")
strings.places: the place's word: "the meadow", "the pond edge", "the rock field", "the wood", "the cave"
strings.note: the frame's zones (station-layouts.md, The frame): a verb phrase of four words or fewer for the action, a label of six words or fewer for the context; no dot-joined parts; "Again: …" is the arm's wording

example.note: Fig: the line plus 16 each side, rounded up to an even width to centre on x 512; it covers the strip, not the mibi or the Portrait module

berth.after: the next held frame when begin brought one forward from the queue, whatever its source (the state after begin: st.sitting held; sitting.mjs beginSitting returns next: true); else nothing. No count, no word

buildChanges: the build has no sitting screen: sitting.mjs holds its rules headless (offer, beginBlock, beginSitting); habitat.mjs offers no Portray
sitting.c on the kit: kit_stage, kit_tiles (cards, chosen, steps), kit_nameTag, kit_stamp; deck and strip plates 1:1
Habitat's Portrait module opens this screen with ✓ Portray {name} (state pose), and, portrayed with its picture held, with ✓ strings.lookPortrait (state portrait)
pose cards and thumbs are derived per mibi and habit (mibiReq with a pose); the window's resident is the same picture at the Habitat factor
the place step and after request the resident ungraded
a portrayed mibi's stamp label carries spread-gilt-corner-16x16 (regions.stamp.portrayed; habitat.json regions.stamp.portrayed)
Cargo's end jumps to state portrait when regions.portrait.offeredFrom lists cargo-end; the hold on sitting crates (cargo.json dockCrates.sitting.revealNote, home.json regions.bay) lifts
